name: character-sheet-rpg
description: Real-life RPG character sheet with Android APK + Health Connect integration

scripts.sync-web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -r index.html manifest.json sw.js css js www/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
